name: Tora Mahato
source:
"I don't want to be taken care of."

A homeroom teacher in Kemonomimi Academy who is the advisor of both the basketball and gardening clubs. He is also a Master of the "Henka no Ishi." 

He's always busy doing something because of his natural physical strength. His strength is comparable to that of the active students of the basketball club.

The emotion that triggers him to become a beast is "anger", but he's undergoing mental training to obtain the Master qualification, and since he's an adult, he doesn't transform at all (there are some exceptions).

[Translated from in-game profile]
